components.gap: Source definitions and arguments not reconstructed: source Definition 7 (amount symmetry, R(B>A)=R(A>B) for all A,B,P; p.269) is used at body lines 220 and 340 but never stated; the source's argument that POP-D is necessary for enumerative induction (Steel 2003, p.271) and its naming of LIK-D as the Law of Likelihood are absent (body 339-342 only reports that Merin finds POP-D attractive); the source's information-theoretic primacy claim for L attributed to Peirce, Turing and Good with Savage 1954 pp.128-140 (p.270) appears only as the handbook's own sufficiency theorem without the source attribution; note 12 (only-if parts in Steel 2003) and note 13 (Z uniqueness result, Crupi and Tentori 2013) are not accounted for.

Body lines 9-10 claim the treatment follows the complete chapter including its twenty notes and references, but the source's historical claims are not reported or distinguished: provenance of D (MacColl 1897, Keynes 1921), Q (Johnson's coefficient of influence; Carnap's name, note 8), L (Peirce, Turing, Good), QL (Good 1950), KO (Kemeny and Oppenheim 1952) and Z (Crupi and Tentori 2013) on p.270; the old-evidence problem's attribution (Glymour 1980) and the reconstructions' sources (Jeffrey 2004; Earman 1992; Fitelson and Hartmann 2015; Hajek and Joyce 2008) on p.268 are paraphrased without sources at body 144-154; the Eells-Fitelson professed-opinion claim on negation (p.272); notes 1, 5 (counterfactual likelihood gloss, Edwards), 11 (Crupi-Tentori axiom names), 17 (Festa's Matthew properties), 19 (Kahneman) and 20 (Merin 1999 function-word application) are not represented. The worked examples themselves (clouds, Trump/Clinton, Dow/seven, drug/cure, Mercury, divisibility, ravens, Linda) are present.

Comparisons are made with Bayesian model comparison (body 274-281), the P19 conjunction chapters (497-504) and the posterior-odds and P18 detection theorems (542-553), but not with the directly linked handbook confirmation units: the raven treatment in sec:p15-hempel-confirmation-and-paradoxes (which itself cross-references sec:p15-r43-rankings), Carnap's relevance quotient and covariance relevance measures in sec:p15-carnap-confirmation-relevance-and-reliability (body 444-446 introduces Carnap's covariance measure without that comparison), and the subjective-probability chapter sec:p15-rationality-4-1 to which source note 1 points. Material differences and objections between Merin's treatment and those units are therefore not preserved.

Source Theorems 1-10, Lemmas 1-4 and note 16 have written proofs in the annex, and Crupi-Chater-Tentori 2013 and Crupi-Tentori 2016 are named as proof dependencies (body 331-334). Not accounted for: the source's argument/evidence claims that POP-D is necessary for enumerative induction (Steel 2003), the Z uniqueness result (note 13), the Eells-Fitelson report of professed opinion on negation symmetries; Skovgaard-Olsen et al. 2016b's evidence that delta-p explicates participants' relevance assessments is only named. No explicit finite dependent-source set is fixed for these claims.
